newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X Minerals shares rise at open.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X Minerals shares rise at open.

text.p: Shares in avidly watched Bre-X Minerals Ltd traded higher on the Toronto Stock Exchange at the open on Thursday in comparatively light volume after being stopped most of Wednesday.
Bre-X was up 0.10 to 3.30 in turnover of about 10,000 shares in the first minute of action. Within five minutes, volume had jumped to over 500,000 shares, with trading steady at 3.30.

Bre-X trade was stopped due to technical difficulties on the Toronto exchange on Wednesday after trading for less than two hours. Despite the abbreviated trading session, Bre-X dominated the market with turnover of 11.7 million shares.
